name: Puppet Master — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Puppet Master from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Puppet Master (Story)" but are not part of the Puppet Master entry, which is unchanged.

Quest (Roll a 1d4)

You wish to control leaders rumored to be weak and vulnerable to magical manipulation.
Your family has suffered humiliation and economic ruin at the hands of a powerful family. You dare not confront them directly, but plan to see to it they believe they are assaulted by enemies on all sides, as you slowly whittle away their influence.
You want to manipulate the existing rulers to gain control of one of their kingdoms, either directly or indirectly.
Rumor indicates that a princess seeks a way to alter the law so she can ascend to the throne when her father dies. You plan to ensure that she achieves this, and gain her favor and trust in the process.
